verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitHub offers CI/CD (github-docs-11) and organization-wide security enforcement like secret scanning and push protection (github-docs-7, github-docs-15), which are governance-relevant, but there is no evidence of explicit coding-standard enforcement mechanisms like branch protection rules, required reviews, CODEOWNERS, or organization-wide rulesets across teams/repos. Missing for 10: branch protection/rulesets enforcement, CODEOWNERS or required review policies, cross-repo policy management tooling, and independent confirmation of policy enforcement at scale.
